# ShareTexts

> ShareTexts is a free web app for moving text, links, photos, videos, and files between any two devices — phone to laptop, iPhone to Windows, Android to Mac — directly in the browser. No app, no account, no cable. Just open ShareTexts on both devices.

Transfers run peer-to-peer over WebRTC: data moves encrypted between the two browsers and the server never sees file contents. Connect two ways: nearby device discovery (both devices on the same Wi-Fi, visible while ShareTexts is open) or, when the network blocks device-to-device traffic, a six-digit live code, a QR code, or a shareable link — those work over any internet connection. Rooms are temporary and close when you're done.

## How to use

1. Open https://sharetexts.online on both devices.
2. Tap your other device in the Nearby list — or use Use another way: a 6-digit code, a QR code, or a share link.
3. Type, paste, or attach anything — it appears on the other device, encrypted.

## Common questions

### Why can't I see my other device in the Nearby list?
Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi with ShareTexts open. Office, guest, hotel, and campus networks often block device-to-device connections. Use a personal hotspot, or connect with a 6-digit code, QR code, or link instead — these work over any connection.

### Do I need to install an app or create an account?
No. ShareTexts runs entirely in the browser on any device with a modern browser: iPhone, iPad, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, Chromebook.

### What can I send?
Text, links, photos, videos, audio, documents — any file type. Links render as tappable cards. Transfers are end-to-end encrypted and never stored on a server.

## Pages

- [About ShareTexts](https://sharetexts.online/about): what ShareTexts is, what it transfers, supported devices.
- [Docs](https://sharetexts.online/docs): full documentation — pairing, transfers, privacy, developer API.
- [How It Works](https://sharetexts.online/guides/how-it-works.html): the signaling + WebRTC architecture explained.
- [Privacy](https://sharetexts.online/privacy): the privacy model — no accounts, no stored content.
- [Security](https://sharetexts.online/guides/security.html): encryption and transport details.

## Facts

- Free, no sign-up; runs in any modern browser with WebRTC (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).
- Works across platforms: iPhone ↔ Windows, Android ↔ Mac, iPhone ↔ Android, any combination.
- Transfer types: text, links, photos, videos, audio, documents, any file.
- End-to-end encrypted via WebRTC (DTLS) with an additional AES-GCM layer; the signaling server relays connection metadata only and never sees content.
- Nearby discovery shows a device only while ShareTexts is open on it, and you can set yourself Hidden; it is never a global user list.
- Stay Connected keeps a room alive until you disconnect it yourself; rejoining is one tap from the landing page, and refreshes/network drops recover automatically.
- Operated at https://sharetexts.online.
